RETIREMENT (added 2026-09-02, the first time a reviewed surface was deleted): a deleted surface retires its claims; a retired claim must name a file that is gone; the ratchet accepts exactly that drop. A retired claim whose file STILL EXISTS is a narrowing, not a retirement, and fails.

The best control read today: assertPrivileges checks the FORBIDDEN direction — that the runtime credential holds no UPDATE (table or column), DELETE, TRUNCATE, or sequence UPDATE — and refuses readiness if it does. Asserting what a credential must NOT have is what turns append-only from an aspiration into a checked claim, and it re-runs on every ping so readyz flips when posture regresses mid-flight. Appends serialize under pg_advisory_xact_lock so the chain cannot fork; a rejected first init is retried single-flight rather than cached forever (a named prior finding); TIMESTAMPTZ is re-serialized to the exact ISO string the hash was computed over so verification recomputes equal across a database round-trip.
